hints.text: 'Finally' and 'sent around' are our indicators — one tells us to pay attention to a particular part of some neighouring fodder, and the other suggests reversal.
Our fodder is 'Anonymous tip: awesome puzzle book' — we'll need to use this material, as directed by the indicators.

The definition is 'stores' — we're looking for a synonym of stores. And, subliminal message: if you're looking for an awesome puzzle book, the Minute Cryptic book is out in AU/NZ now, and in UK/EU on 4 September!
